notes: base_id is the table's variation_group: skins (id suffix _s01/_s02) and story or tutorial duplicates share a base_id with the canonical unit, and carry is_variant. Variants reuse the base unit's skill ids.

stat_seed holds the datamined personality values the client feeds into its base-stat formula; that formula lives in pass/public.pass (separately encrypted) and is NOT decoded here, so no derived lv60 stats are emitted.
